messages:
Tess (People Ops): Hi team  I'm putting together a very short 'first 10 days + 30/60/90' cheat-sheet for new managers joining next week. Goal: actionable, one page. Thoughts?

Ravi (Hiring Manager): Love it. Can we include a tiny stakeholder slide they must send by day 7 (who owns infra, security, product, recruiting)?

Kai (Eng Manager): Add an ops checklist: oncall shadow within 10 days, staging RBAC granted by default, prod after security signoff. Also flag Redwood Dedicated/GPU quota request for model teams.

Maya (Onboarding Ops): We'll attach the quick checklist to the offer pack and add a Day-7 pulse email (3 Qs: missing accounts, role clarity, blockers).

Tess (People Ops): Draft cheat-sheet below. Short, copy-paste friendly.

Tess (People Ops): FIRST 48 HOURS
- [ ] Confirm Google, Slack, GitHub accounts
- [ ] SSO/MFA & VPN set up
- [ ] Redwood Console: viewer; request billing if needed
- [ ] Add buddy + schedule 1st shadow
- [ ] Join #team, #eng, #oncall, #hiring

Tess (People Ops): FIRST 10 DAYS (musts)
- Meet every direct report (30m) using 30/60/90 template
- Send 1-slide stakeholder map by Day 7
- Complete oncall shadow (if applicable) or schedule within 10 days
- Verify CI/CD/deploy bot access and repo perms

Tess (People Ops): MEETING GUIDELINES
- Keep interviews <=2/day for first 2 weeks
- Avoid back-to-back all-day meetings; cap at ~4 hours/day
- Block 1h daily for focus + 2 x 30m office hours each week

Ravi (Hiring Manager): Also include hiring expectations: candidate scorecard in <=48h and debrief within 72h.

Kai (Eng Manager): Ops addendum: request Dedicated/GPU quotas early if team will run inference. Include link to model catalog and deploy policy doc.

Tess (People Ops): WHO TO ASK (quick)
- Onboarding: Maya / Tess
- Infra: Kai / DevInfra
- Security: Mia
- Recruiting: Ravi

OnboardBot: Checklist template copied to /docs/onboarding/manager-mini-cheatsheet.md

Tess (People Ops): I'll finalize and attach this to offers tonight. Thanks for the quick feedback! :white_check_mark:
